subject: [NAME] - spoke to Michael - should we chat?
text:
Hey [NAME],

The team recently spoke to Michael Morton, who mentioned Videa has taken a
few different approaches to annotation over the years (various in-house &
third-party tools) - so was curious to get your perspective,

Reaching out as we've seen several Dental AI teams move over to Encord in
the past six months - as other providers pivot away from annotation as
their core focus, we've made our big bet on continuing to develop a
future-proof multimodal platform

Appreciate you may not be looking to change just now - but would love to
hear your perspective & see if there's anything we can help with either in
the immediate or long-term,

Let me know if you'd be open to having a quick chat in the coming weeks,

subject: partner with Senseye
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on the Topcon investment! As someone with ADHD cousins, it's
exciting to see how you're driving innovation in mental health clinical
research.

We're working with labs and clinics like Viz.ai, Rapid AI, KCL, and
Stanford Med to streamline their training data pipeline for perception
models - improving accuracy, speeding time to market, and reducing
operational overhead. Since you're building your own CV models, I thought
this could be relevant.

Quick context: Encord is a data development platform for advanced CV and
multimodal AI (DICOM, image, video, senor), providing native video
annotation, auto labeling, and HITL review. We're ~5yrs old with $50M
raised, and supporting 200+ AI teams.

Would love your thoughts - are you open to a quick chat Tue to Thu morning
PT next week?

subject: Coffee at ICCV?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're attending ICCV this year so I wanted to reach out. We've been
working with UVEYE and Tractable on developing models for vehicle damage
detection - hope we can find some time to exchange perspectives at the
conference.

In case Encord is new to you - we help over 200 AI teams improve data
quality for model development. We focus unifying auto-annotation with
curation and model evaluation capabilities, so ML teams like yours can
focus on identifying the most impactful data groups to improve model
predictions.

We'll be at ICCV Tues (10/21) to Thurs (10/23) - ler me know if you're open
to a coffee at our booth?

subject: Groundlight <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed live vision insights with minimal setup and natural language
queries on your website - assuming you are building vision models in house.

As your deployment scales, I suspect the edge-case backlog, video streams,
and sensor diversity start to demand heavier annotation, QA, and model
evaluation to maintain reliability. We've been helping CV/ML teams solve
exactly this problem - helping teams capture, annotate, and manage edge
cases and multi-camera/sensor sync.

Quick context: we're a data development and annotation platform for
advanced CV and multimodal AI. We're ~5yrs old, $50M raised, and have
supported 200! AI teams like Boston dynamics, PI, and Twelve Labs.

Looks like there's room for collaboration - would you be open for a quick
chat next week?

subject: Partnership with [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded LVT and Flock Safety to help them streamline data
pipeline for VLM and perception models training - and your company has come
up in a few conversations.

A lot of smart camera and surveillance companies hit the wall when
real-world training data outgrows open source tools like CVAT that are not
video-first, handling billions of CCTV frames and edge cases become tough
quickly. That's why we're seeing a trend of teams shifting from multi-tool
stack (CVAT, Voxel 51, Segments + Services) to Encord, consolidating
annotation, QA, and model evaluation.

Quick context: Encord is a data development platform for advanced CV and
multimodal AI. We've helped 200+ AI teams improve training data quality at
scale.

Would love a quick chat if you are also exploring ways to increase
labelling throughput. I'm flexible Tue-Thu morning PT but happy to adjust
for you.
